controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Voyager 2 monochrome mosaic with source photometric correction. Native detail is about 2.9 km per pixel at best; photographed shadows and image seams remain. Gray grid marks missing observations.
controls.summary: Voyager 2 images with detail as fine as 2.9 km per pixel. Shadows and seams remain; gray grid: no observations.

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Voyager stereo elevations with published limb-profile data, in kilometres relative to the source reference ellipsoid. Fixed relief lighting reveals slopes; gray grid marks missing measurements. 2.88 km grid spacing is not uniform effective elevation resolution.
controls.summary: Voyager stereo and limb heights relative to the source ellipsoid. Detail varies; gray grid: no data.
controls.title: Voyager stereo elevations with published limb-profile data, in kilometres relative to the source reference ellipsoid. Fixed relief lighting reveals slopes; gray grid marks missing measurements. 2.88 km grid spacing is not uniform effective elevation resolution.

controls.label: Geology
controls.description: Ten historical geologic units digitized from Voyager-era mapping. Registration reconstructed from crater landmarks; four independent checks differ by 0.33–0.83° (about 4.5–11.4 km). Colors identify interpreted units, not measured composition. Gray grid marks unmapped or unresolved overlapping units; structural linework is not shown.
controls.summary: Historical interpreted units; reconstructed registration. Gray grid: unmapped or conflicting units.
